acceptance.text: Login and register screens offer Google sign-in: google_sign_in obtains an ID token (server client = Google Web client ID) and POST /api/auth/google {idToken} returns the app session token
Session token persists only in secure storage; Authorization Bearer is used for API calls; logout clears local storage even when remote revocation fails
Cancellation returns to the prior unauthenticated state without an error banner
HTTP 400/401/409/429/500/503, network and missing-token failures map to distinct localized messages (vi/ja)
No automatic linking of existing password accounts; 409 is surfaced to the user
No credential or token values in logs, exceptions or messages
Unit, widget and integration tests cover state transitions, cancellation, errors and secure persistence
